whenToUse: Forms with few fields on narrow screens, such as login or payment.
The design requires all fields to share one height.
whenNotToUse: Fields with long labels or that need a hint (use a text field).
Values are often prefilled by autofill (the label only shows small).
Inputs with a built-in browser display, such as dates.

alternatives.name: Text Field
alternatives.reason: The basic form with the label above the field.

accessibility: It's a real label element, not a placeholder, so the name stays after a value is entered.
CSS :placeholder-shown tells the states apart, so it works without JavaScript.
The raised label still keeps a text contrast of 4.5:1.
The motion turns off with reduced motion.
